name: 美团 LongCat 开放平台

freeTierSummary.zh-CN: 官方「邀请有礼」：邀请新用户完成实名认证，邀请人与受邀人各得 1000 万 Tokens，叠加平台实名赠送的 1000 万最高可得 2000 万，奖励 30 个自然日内有效、单账号最多邀请 50 个实名账号；受邀人首购返实付 5%，团长邀满 3 人返 10%、满 20 人返 50%。LongCat-2.5 支持 1M 上下文与图片/视频理解，兼容 OpenAI 与 Anthropic 协议；名额与细则以活动页为准。
freeTierSummary.en: Official invite program: an invited new user who completes real-name verification gives both sides 10M tokens, stacking with the platform's own 10M gift for up to 20M (valid 30 days, max 50 invitees). First purchase rebates 5%; a group leader gets 10% at 3 invitees and 50% at 20. LongCat-2.5 has a 1M context and speaks OpenAI plus Anthropic; see the campaign page.

zh-CN: 通过邀请链接注册并登录 LongCat 开放平台（活动仅限个人新用户）
进入「账号信息及配置」完成个人实名认证，双方各得 1000 万 Tokens，可与平台实名赠送的 1000 万叠加至 2000 万
奖励以 Token 资源包实时到账，30 个自然日内有效；单账号最多邀请 50 个实名账号
购买资源包或充值按量付费即触发拼团返现：受邀人返实付 5%，团长邀满 3 人返 10%、满 20 人返 50%
前往「API Keys」创建密钥（仅创建时可见），接口地址填 https://api.longcat.chat/openai/v1，模型填 LongCat-2.5
en: Sign up and log in to LongCat through the invite link (the campaign is for new individual users only)
Complete personal real-name verification in Account info & settings: both sides get 10M tokens, stacking with the platform's own 10M gift for up to 20M
Rewards arrive as token packs valid for 30 days; one account can invite at most 50 verified users
Buying a token pack or topping up pay-as-you-go triggers the group rebate: 5% for the invitee, 10% for the leader at 3 invitees and 50% at 20
Create the key on the API Keys page (shown once) and use https://api.longcat.chat/openai/v1 with model LongCat-2.5
